verdict.rationale: Paddle is API-first, so it can be driven without the dashboard. It offers Bearer API-key auth with granular permissions and automated key rotation via AWS Secrets Manager, plus official server SDKs (Node, Python, Go, PHP). A separate sandbox environment with its own `pdl_sdbx_` keys gives the same APIs for automated testing, and a hosted MCP endpoint accepts API-key auth for non-interactive agent use. missing for 10: an official CLI, explicit CI/pipeline integration guidance (e.g., running webhook simulation or test suites in CI), independent hands-on corroboration of headless/CI usage.
